text: Uncle Keenbean is a grummle located in Kota Basecamp in Kun-Lai Summit.
Uncle Cloverleaf is a grummle found in One Keg in Kun-Lai Summit. He sent the adventurers to inspire Hiding Guides.

The Underbough of Kri'vess is undeveloped forested land surrounding the great tree. Populated only by Rankbite Tortoises and Longshadow Mushan, the Underbough is bordered by the Shado-Pan Garrison, Deadtalker's Plateau, the Gai-Cho Battlefield, Fire Camp Gai-Cho, and the Lower Sumprushes.

Uncle Gao Stormstout is a pandaren that Chen Stormstout meets upon his first visit to the Stormstout Brewery in the Valley of the Four Winds. The meeting is not an amicable one, as Gao is uncharacteristically cold for a pandaren and shuns Chen due to his surname, despite being a distant Stormstout himself (however he implies his resentment goes beyond just Chen himself). Despite his demeanor, he's essentially an incompetent bumbler and his attempts at making a better brew result in the Brewery becoming overrun by invaders as he neglects the entire place. After clearing the mess in the brewery, Gao informed Chen and Li Li about the other Stormstouts who had gone to fight the mantid. He also s
Corrupted Thistle Bears are brown bears found in Cliffspring Hollow in Darkshore.

Uncle Bigpocket is a grummle located at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit, where he sells yak mounts. Madam Lani is standing next to him, complaining to the "shrewd little negotiator" about his steep prices. __NOTOC__
Unclaimed Black Market Container is purchased on the Black Market Auction House. Bidding originally started at , but later was increased to .

Uncle Stonefield was the husband of "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield who gave her Bernice's Necklace before dying on his last campaign. The Lion-Stamped Gloves and Uncle Stonefield's Pants belonged to him.

Underpaid Engineers are goblin engineers located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar who first appeared during Battlefield: Barrens before being removed. Prior to the battle for the Broken Shore, they reappeared working on Megaton and Cannons-In-Boxes alongside Bilgewater Blastmasters. They are also seen at the blockade after the battle.

The Underhold is a massive underground compound deep below Orgrimmar and is accessed through an elevator within the Ragefire Chasm. It was used by Warchief Garrosh Hellscream and his Kor'kron as the True Horde headquarters. It contained some of the True Horde's most dangerous machinery and top-secret operations known only to the high ranking members loyal to the Warchief himself. Following the siege, the Underhold was unused until the invasion of the Burning Legion, where Vol'jin opened the halls to provide shelter for those who were affected by the Legion. At some point later, Sylvanas Windrunner progressively converted the area into a military installation as Garrosh had, using it to train

The Underhold Nexus is the central chamber of the Underhold leading off into several other chambers. Automatic defenses are found in this area, along with guards, and even some shredders which are still crated up. Two doors on the entrance side, from the Kor'kron Barracks, are unable to be opened, so its unknown what could be beyond those doors. In the far section of the nexus to the right leads to the Artifact Storage and the Menagerie chambers. To the left the Siegeworks is found while straight ahead leads to the Chamber of the Paragons and The Inner Sanctum.
Undying Flames are flames summoned by Time-Twisted Seers at the Obsidian Dragonshrine of End Time.
Undertow Totem was a totem summoned by Wavebinder Se'sha in the Northern Barrens.
Uncleft Hooves drop from clefthooves in and the garrison Salvage Yard.
Uncle Tallmug is a grummle located at the Broketooth Outpost in Kun-Lai Summit.
Underground Map can be obtained from Blingtron 5000 Gift Package rewarded from Blingtron 5000 (quest).

The Undead Elite Guard (previously called Elite Guard in The Culling) was an elite faction of undead Scourge led by Mal'Ganis. It acted as the main assault force converting Plagued Citizens into zombies during The Culling in Stratholme during the Third War. Tichondrius was also one of its leaders. Its team color was green in The Culling and later red in Trudging through the Ashes.
Under Color: Sketchbook Volume 1 is an artbook by Glenn Rane, containing sketches pertaining to the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game.
Uncle Stonefield's Pants are a quest reward from Goldtooth (quest) which begins with Billy Maclure in Elwynn Forest.

The Undead Caravan was a small Scourge force tasked with infecting the villages near Hearthglen and sending the newly raised undead from each village to strike at the town. The caravan's ultimate goal was to infect the largest village and construct a new undead stronghold to the north of Hearthglen. The plagued grain was distribued on meat wagons which were accompanied by ghouls, necromancers, and abominations, as well as the newly turned zombies.
__NOTOC__ Undertow is a water fury located in the Tanaan Channel off the coast of .
Underking or Under-King is a title used by both nerubian crypt lords and the drogbar. __NOTOC__
The Underpale is a cavern below populated by the exiled pale orcs.
Uncorrupted Val Blood is a quest reward from The Emerald Queen.
Undulation is a Restoration shaman talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Unleash Life.
Underlight Slaves are murlocs found in Kal'delar in Val'sharah. They are being dragged along by Murkwater Slavers.
Undisputed Champion's Shirt is a quest reward from Ty'thar (quest). To complete the quest, you must successfully challenge Ty'thar.
Underking's Fist is a quest reward from Neltharion's Lair: Death to the Underking.

The Uncrowned Insignia is a quest reward from The Final Shadow. Despite the flavor text, every entrance is still accessible even if the item is no longer in possession. Even talking to the some vendors throughout Dalaran will still show the player an entrance to the Hall of Shadows. If the player loses this item, Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Hall of Shadows can provide replacements.

The Uncrowned Vault is an area of the Hall of Shadows located behind the Cantrips & Crows building. It is here where you find the Crucible of the Uncrowned which lets you spend artifact traits and change appearance of your artifact weapon.
Undigested Teeth are looted from Demonwaste Piles in Suramar while on the quest The Key Is Around Here Somewhere....
Undivided Hide is skinned from creatures in the Broken Isles.
Undertuned Attunement Crystal is a quest reward from I'll Just Leave This Here.
Undead Battle-Training Stones are contained in Mystery Bag, Big Bag of Pet Supplies and as possible reward from pet World Quests.
Uncooked Ribs are provided as an objective for Ribs for the Sentinels. They can be cooked into Delicious Ribs.
Uncrowned Poison Set is a quest reward from Meld Into the Shadows.
Uncrowned Opportunist is a goblin located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore. He sneaks around near the Nether Disruptor.
The Underbelly Descent is the name of the entrances to the Underbelly. It is considered a sanctuary. The corrupt guard Raethan is here.

Underbelly Tycoon is an exploration achievement earned from looting 20,000 Sightless Eyes in Dalaran's Underbelly. Eyes are awarded from killing players and looted from chests when guards are taking a break, or looted from the rare creatures when guards are on duty.
Uncrowned Blacksmith is a hobgoblin located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Uncrowned Bruisers are hobgoblins located in Hall of Shadows guarding the body of Amber Kearnen. They are also found at Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Undamaged Warp Hound Corpses dropped from warp stalkers east of Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Underlight Emerald unlocks two hidden appearances for the Underlight Angler.
Undergrell Ringleader is a grell encountered at Bladesong's Retreat in Val'sharah as part of the Undergrell Attack vignette.
The Underrot is a dungeon in Battle for Azeroth. It is entered from the Altar of Rot in the pit that surrounds the Uldir complex. The name underrot also refers to G'huun's corruption in Nazmir.

The Underbelly Guard are human and high elven guardians of Dalaran's Underbelly. They are led by Guard Captain Raethan. They are said to be corrupt, but vigilant. They were attacked by the demons of the Burning Legion.

__NOTOC__ Undead Miners are undead located in the Hollowstone Mine in the Grizzly Hills. Originally affiliated with Silverbrook, they were cursed to undeath by the Shade of Arugal for refusing to join the Wolfcult. Their former friend Petrov wants to put their souls at rest.
Undead Priests were Forsaken located in and Gorgrond. They were taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall garrison.
Undying Aesthetic is about collecting a full set of Naxxramas armor for one class.
The Underlight is a group of murlocs inhabiting Val'sharah. They also have scouts in the Great Sea.

The Undergorge is a gorge leading down into a cave in Val'sharah. Following the river that leads in from The Tidal Marsh brings you to the entrance of the cave. Inside, Boneflux resides with its prisoner - Keeper Remulos.
The Underwater Passage is a sub-aquatic tunnel in western Tirisfal Glades that leads from the lake of Tyr's Fall in the Whispering Forest to the Tomb of Tyr beneath the lake's floor.
Undersea Custodians are helsquids located in the Abyssal Approach in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Underbelly Vagrants are homeless ogres in the Underbelly in Highmaul.
__NOTOC__ The Underrot Crawg Harness drops from the Unbound Abomination in the Underrot.
Understone Demolishers are drogbar located in Neltharion's Lair. They transform into Colossal Charskins.
Understone Drudges are drogbar located on the Lost Road in Neltharion's Lair.
Understone Drummers are drogbar located in Neltharion's Lair.
Understone Lashers are drogbar located in Neltharion's Lair.

Underlight Blessing is a fishing artifact trait. It is linked to the Surface Tension trait. This trait lets the character to breathe underwater, swim rapidly, and turn into a small remora when the artifact is equipped and underwater.
Uncontrolled Growths are vines located in the Southern Barrens.
Uncrowned Saboteurs are goblins located at the Garrison of the Fel on the Broken Shore during The Burning Keys. They provide Pile of Vanishing Powders and Substandard Sappers.
Uncrowned Agents are pandaren, orcs, gnomes, and Forsaken located on the Broken Shore during its second assault.
The Undulating Blue Sac summons a Bloated Bloodfeaster, a blood tick companion.
__NOTOC__ Underlight Scouts are deep sea murlocs located in the seafloor of the Great Sea.
Uncle Pete wrote the Writ of Sanity. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Uncle Sezahjin's Fried chicken is a quest reward from Vol'duni Fried Chicken and can also be purchased from Sezahjin at a cost of after completion of the quest.
Underwater Explosives were explosives planted aboard the Iron Horde battleship in Grommar harbor.
Underbelly Banquet is sold by Thuni in Dalaran for 650 Sightless Eye.
Uncut Chrysoberyls are looted from Chrysoberyl Outcropping in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Underrot Ticks are blood ticks located in the Sanctuary of Blood in the Underrot.
Undol the Herdmaster is a yaungol located on the expedition isles.
Uncrowned Recruiters are humans located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. They only appear when the Uncrowned control the area.
Undersea Usurper is a meta-achievement that is earned through questing, finding treasues, killing rares and other objectives in Nazjatar.
Underlord Xerxiz is a C'Thrax located in Zul'Nazman in Nazmir.

Underlight Sealamp is a toy that has a chance to drop from the following elite naga and elementals in Nazjatar: *Abyss Elemental *Hand of Azshara *Imperial Defender *Voice of the Queen *Zanj'ir Bulwark
__NOTOC__ The Underlight Pearl is the artifact forge for the fishermen, situated at the Dalaran above the fountain at Broken Isles. To interact with it you must equip the Underlight Angler artifact.
Undercove Crushers drop from Blackwater Behemoth in the Eternal Palace.
Uncrowned Footpads are located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Undead Brawler is a pet battle achievement earned by winning 10 PvP pet battles through Find Battle with a full team of level 25 Undead pets.
Under the Seams is a collection achievement earned by collecting an armor set from The Eternal Palace.
Underhold Elite Guards are Forsaken located in the Underhold during Stay of Execution.
Underhold Grunts are orcs located in the Underhold during Stay of Execution. They are called by Magister Hathorel to attack the rescuers of Baine Bloodhoof.
Underpaid Interns are goblins located in the Underhold during Stay of Execution.

The Undermine Insurance Unlimited is a goblin organization focusing on insurance from financial loss. One of their known final transactions involved the "mysterious" fire at KTC Headquarters. Following the destruction of Kezan, it is unknown what happened to it.
Undying Army is a reputation achievement earned by reaching Exalted status with the Undying Army.
Undulating Tides is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on Benthic Azerite Armor from Nazjatar and the Eternal Palace.
An Undulating Blood Burrower drops from the Pulsing Leech at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. When picked up, it's automatically consumed to grant the buff for 30 minutes.
Undulating Anomalies are haunts located in Cocyrus in the Maw.
Undergrell Mobilehelm drops from Undergrell Ringleader at Bladesong's Retreat in Val'sharah.
The Underbelly Portals are portals located in the Underbelly in Dalaran.
The Underweald is one of the four Deep Unknown locations that Marasmius sends players to in Into the Unknown.

Undying Army Commendations are rewarded by various quests and world quests. When a quest that grants an Undying Army Commendation is completed, you automatically receive reputation with the Undying Army.
Undying Army Weapon Cache is sold by Clyde in Maldraxxus for 1,000 Reservoir Anima.
transforming]] Under the Illusion is the climax of the "They Could Be Anyone" side-chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign.
Uncorrupted Razorwing Egg is found in a nest in the Vault of Secrets in Korthia. Interacting with it spawns Reliwik the Defiant.
Undying Darkhound's Harness is a darkhound ground mount occasionally found in the War Chest of the Undying Army, rewarded for completing the Necrolord Assault on Perdition Hold in the Maw.
Unconscious Monks are pandaren located in the Greenstone Village scenario.
Undying Chill Shoulderpads drop from Nalthor the Rimebinder in The Necrotic Wake.

The Under Development (or "underdev") was a section of the official site. It often contained lore information and articles to go along with the patch notes. Brief introductions to each patch were also listed, and the patches were in inverse release order. In the 2010 revamp of the Official Site, they added a Patch Notes section that acted as the successor of the Underdev articles. They still referred to the overviews of this section as "Under dev" up until the end of Mists of Pandaria, with the lore-based "Under dev" sections and links being discontinued beginning with Warlords of Draenor.
Uncovered Chestguard is a quest reward from Heartfelt Appreciation.
Undying Commanders are Maldraxxi gladiators located in Provis Terra in Zereth Mortis.
Undergrowth Lurkers are spiders located in the Felblight in Tanaan Jungle.
The Underground Circler's Crossbow drops from Akkaris at the Arrangement Index in Zereth Mortis.
Underrot Grotto Tenders drop from Cragmaw the Infested in The Underrot. They are also looted from Challenger's Cache.
Unchecked Aggression is a conduit for guardian druids. It drops from Sludgefist in Castle Nathria, Dessia the Decapitator in the Theater of Pain, and Skolex in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.

A wagon of Undelivered Mail is located next to an Enlightened Pilgrim in the Slumbering Vault in Zereth Mortis. The mail can only be read during Seeking the Unknown, and is the only one of the readable objects in Haven that advance the quest.
Undying Blademasters are Maldraxxi skeletons located in the Maw and Zereth Mortis.
Undulating Maneuvers is a soulbind trait granted by Plague Deviser Marileth. It is exclusive with Viscous Trail.
__NOTOC__ Undulating Foliage is found inside the Catalyst Wards in Zereth Mortis.
Uncle Mako is a pandaren located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. Valonius is telling him about his dreams.
__NOTOC__ The Undying Deathroach is a deathroach companion that has a chance to drop from , which in turn drop from rare mobs in the Maw.
Undead Battler of the Dragon Isles is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the elite pets and trainers of the Dragon Isles with a team of all level 25 Undead pets.

The undead starting experience takes place in Deathknell in western Tirisfal Glades. In it, freshly raised Forsaken characters get to make heads of their new surroundings, take on Scourge remnants and fight to defeat the Rotbrain rebellion, before departing for Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Understanding Their Grace becomes available after reaching Renown 15 with the Maruuk Centaur.

The Undying Challenge was the first esports tournament for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic. It was introduced on 6 October 2022 and took place on 22-23 October the same year. The challenge placed two of the top speedrunning guilds, Progress (Firemaw EU) and SPACEFORCE (Eranikus US), with basic level 80 characters and they have a limited time to gear up to then speedrun through Naxxramas without dying.
Undigested Hochenblume Petal drops from Kangalo in the Forbidden Reach.
Unconscious Watchmen are humans located in Gilneas after Leader of the Pack (quest).
Under the Weather is an exploration achievement earned by completing a Froststone Vault Primal Storm of every element.
Undead Battler of Zaralek Caverm is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the pet trainers of Zaralek Cavern with a team of all level 25 Undead pets.

Undeath Metal is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Plans: Undeath Metal. This is part of the Secrets of Naxxramas method of acquiring new Tier 3 pieces. It requires the following reagents: * Wartorn Scrap (50) * Arcanite Bar (10) * Essence of Undeath (6) * Dark Rune (2) * Frozen Rune
Undelivered Shipment of Smokes is found on a cart near Ezra Grimm's Premium Tobacco in Stratholme Main Gate. It can be returned to Rory in return for a Tobacco-Filled Candle.
Underlight Flickerwings are dustmoths located in Zaralek Cavern.
Underlight Moths are dustmoths located in the eastern parts of Zaralek Cavern.
Underlight Queen is a rare elite dustmoth that spawns in the Crystal Fields in Zaralek Cavern.
Unconscious Worker is a red drakonid being healed by a Panicked Mender in the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken during Chaos and Commotion.
Underlight Conjurer's Vestment is sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Underlight Conjurer's Gloves are sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Underlight Conjurer's Arcanocowl is sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Underlight Conjurer's Trousers are sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Underlight Conjurer's Aurora is sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Undermoth is a dustmoth companion. It does not appear to be available.
Underlight Headwrap drops from Underlight Queen in the Crystal Fields in Zaralek Cavern.
Underhanded Upper Hand is an Outlaw rogue talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sepsis.
Unending Breath is a warlock spell, cast on themselves or their allies to help them breathe underwater and increase their swim speed for 10 minutes.

A unitId (or unit token) identifies a unit by their relationship to the player as a target, party member, pet, or other such role. Several API functions accept unitId as an argument for whom the action applies, though some functions only accept a subset of possible values. UnitIds are case insensitive.

.]] Some items in the game are flagged as unique. You can only have one copy of a unique item in all of your inventory, including what you have in the bank. If you have an opportunity to acquire another of the same item then you will be unable to. For example, if a mob drops the same item that you already possess, you won't be able to loot the item. If the mob is skinnable this will also prevent you from skinning the mob. This can be particularly troublesome with unique bag items since you want to have over a dozen bags total preferably. .]] .]] .]] A unicorn (or monohorn) is a type of courser native to Azeroth and the Shadowlands, resembling a horse with a horn growing from its forehead. The Quel'dorei steed are descended from a fine line of horses that once grazed near the shores of the Well of Eternity. Many unicorns live on the Broken Isles. The majority of the nightborne refer to zhevras as "monohorns" instead of "unicorns", claiming that it is a much more fitting name, though there is debate among their community. They consider them a rare breed, their distinctive hides being used for all manner of fashion, including hats, coat linings, and other fine apparel. At least some unicorns are tied to the Emerald Dream. Dream
A recipe sold by a vendor in unlimited quantities. Some vendors may also require reputation with a specific faction.
__NOTOC__ Unholy Swords are animated runeblades that can be found in Naxxramas.
__NOTOC__ Permanently enchant a melee weapon to often inflict a curse on the target, inflicting Shadow damage and reducing their melee damage.

A unit is any object in Warcraft I, II and III that can be selected. Other kinds of objects are Items, Doodads, Regions, Cameras and Terrain. Units also refers to a sub-group of units, as opposed to Buildings. Interestingly, it can also be used as a subgroup of even that, as opposed to Heroes.

Unliving Residents are the ghosts of former villagers living in the small settlement below Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. They are level 69 - 70 and also inhabit the Master's Cellar below the village. Since the Burning Legion's third invasion and the attack on Karazhan, the ghosts has been killed.

Unliving Caretakers are the human ghosts of former caretakers living in the small settlement below Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. They are level 69-70 and also inhabit the Master's Cellar below the village. Since the Burning Legion's third invasion and the attack on Karazhan, the ghosts has been killed.
Unhatched Jubling Egg is a unique item. After a week in the player's possession, the item can be used, at which point the egg 'hatches' and becomes A Jubling's Tiny Home.
Unholy Axes are animated runeblades that can be found in Naxxramas.
Unholy Staves are animated objects that can be found in Naxxramas.
Unfortunate Measures is part of the Reclaiming Sunstrider Isle quest chain and a blood elf only quest.

Unidentified Plant Parts drop from various mobs and herbs in Zangarmarsh. Herbalists can also gather them from the bog giants in The Dead Mire and The Spawning Glen, and Rotting Forest-Ragers in The Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest.
__NOTOC__ Unkor the Ruthless is an ogre located in the center of Bleeding Hollow Ruins in Terokkar Forest. He is found with a pair of Boulderfist Invaders.
The Unhatched Sprite Darter Egg is provided as an objective for An Orphan Looking For a Home.
Unfired Key Mold is provided as an objective for Hotter than Hell.
Unkempt Pants are a zone drop from level 1 to 5 mobs in Eversong Woods.
Unkempt Bracers are a zone drop from the following Level 1 to 5 mobs in Eversong Woods.
The Unfinished Headpiece is provided by Parshah to energize it near the essence of Gul'dan for Imbuing the Headpiece.
Unfinished Skeleton Key is created from the Skeleton Key Mold.
The Unforged Seal of Ascension is contained within Vaelan's Gift.

Unleashed Hellions are level 70-71 terrorguards located in and around the Dawning Square of the Isle of Quel'Danas. They are involved in the following quests: *The Battle for the Sun's Reach Armory *The Battle Must Go On

Unit flags contain information for a unit in the combat log. They are returned from COMBAT_LOG_EVENT sourceFlags and destFlags params. A unit can only be one type from each of the following four categories: # Type: The way the unit is currently being controlled. # Controller: Who currently controls this unit - an NPC or a player. # Reaction: The unit's reaction, relative to you - hostile, friendly or neutral. # Affiliation: If the unit belongs to you (your character, pet, mind controlled) or is in your party or raid, or neither.
Unloaded Zapper is provided as an objective for Zapper Fuel.
Unlit Torches are provided as an objective for the following quests: * More Torch Catching * Torch Catching
The Unforged Runic Breastplate is located in the Blackrock Spire.
The Unguarded Thunder Ale Barrel is located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Once Jarven Thunderbrew is Distracted, this barrel becomes available.
__NOTOC__ Unholy Aura was a Death knight talent located on tier 7 of the Unholy tree.
Unholy Command was a Death Knight talent located in the first tier of the Unholy Tree.
__NOTOC__ Unholy Archons are Onslaught Raven Archons, in Scarlet Point in the Dragonblight, who have transformed when near death.
Unliving Choker drops Withered Trolls near Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.
Unidentified Ore is provided as an objective for Gerenzo's Orders (2).

The Unkempt Armor set is a collection of gray cloth items that drop randomly from mobs between levels 1 and 5 in the Blood Elf beginning area, Sunstrider Isle and Falthrien Academy. It is equivalent to the Frayed collection world drop for beginning areas. There is no set bonus. This quality gear is actually very nice cloth armor in the starting levels.
Unending Fury is a talent in the Fury tree, you will need to spend 50 points in Fury to max it. It increases the damage done by Slam, Whirlwind and Bloodthirst by 2% per rank.
The Unlocked Chest can be found at Shield Hill in Howling Fjord.
Unfair Advantage is a 40 point Rogue talent located in the 9th tier of the Combat Tree. This talent gives an auto attack that deals mainhand weapon damage whenever the rogue dodges.

The Unlucky Footman was a footman that was captured by the Blackrock clan during the Third War, he, alongside some villagers, were sacrificed to the demon masters of the warlocks of the Blackrock clan.
__NOTOC__ Unliving Swine are undead boars that wander outside Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Unit Darkshire is a group of soldiers from Darkshire as part of the Valiance Expedition who have been sent to the Dragonblight.
Unit Goldshire is a group of soldiers from Goldshire who have been sent to Howling Fjord as part of the Valiance Expedition.
Mr. Chilly is an aquatic companion pet obtained through a promotional event.

Most mounts can be categorized by the type of creature or device you are riding. While these mounts can also be categorized that way, there is only one example of that type of mount. This, then, is a page to describe all the oddball or unique mounts available.

"Unknown Crusader's Diary" is an in-game book which appears in the Scarlet Enclave during the death knight starting quest chain. It appears after the creation of the Scarlet Onslaught and is visible in the phase after completing The Scarlet Apocalypse.
Unliving Stalkers are draenei ghosts summoned by Auchenai Vindicators in Auchenai Crypts.
Unliving Sorcerers are draenei ghosts summoned by Auchenai Vindicators in Auchenai Crypts.
Unliving Soldiers are draenei ghosts summoned by Auchenai Vindicators in Auchenai Crypts.
Unliving Clerics are draenei ghosts summoned by Auchenai Vindicators in Auchenai Crypts.
Undying Minions can be found laboring in the Broken Front of Icecrown, and also marching in squads of five at Mord'rethar: The Death Gate.
Unearthing Uldum is a quest achievement earned for completing quests in Uldum. Requirement for the meta achievement Loremaster of Cataclysm.

Unjari Feltongue is a jungle troll warlock trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. Her minion, the imp Fiznak, wears a voodoo mask. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade and later joined the Black Harvest on the Dreadscar Rift. She also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
United Nations is a guild reputation achievement earned by raising 55 reputations to Exalted. Only the unique reputations of characters who have status with the guild are counted.

Unleash Frost is the spell triggered by Unleash Elements when you have Frostbrand Weapon active. It has two separate effects: it deals frost damage to your target and slows the target's movement speed for a few seconds. See the articles on Unleash Elements and Frostbrand Weapon for more information about this spell.

Unleash Wind is a shaman spell, triggered by using Unleash Elements while Windfury Weapon is active. It has two separate effects: it throws a spectral version of your weapon at your target, and grants you a buff which increases your attack speed for your next six melee swings. See :Unleash Elements for more information about this spell.

Unleash Earth is the spell triggered by Unleash Elements when you have Rockbiter Weapon active. Unlike the other unleash spells, it has only one effect: it forces your target to attack you for 5 seconds. This has no effect in PvP. See the articles on Unleash Elements and Rockbiter Weapon for more information about this spell.
Unidentified Cooking Utensil is a quest reward from The Titans' Terminal. Despite the name, the weapon model is clearly a frying pan.
Unearthed Fossils are skeletal wind serpents found in southern Tanaris. __NOTOC__

Ungarl is the furbolg Chieftain of the Blackmaw tribe. The Alliance hoped to include them as an ally, but this was foiled by a Horde agent. Ungarl is located deep within the barrow of Blackmaw Hold in Azshara.
Unexpected Backup is an epic Thrown weapon geared towards Protection Warriors.
Uninvited Tentacles are tentacles located in the Twilight Highlands.
The Unlit Challenger's Torch is provided as an objective for The Challenger's Fires. Once lit it changes into a Torch of Prismatic Flame.
Unga Treasure-Hiders are hozen located in Unga Ingoo in Krasarang Wilds.
Unfettered Spirits were level 29 - 30 wraiths that could once be found inside the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery.
Unleashed Spirits were mogu ghosts located in Emperor's Approach in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They traveled in packs of five.
Unliving Atal'ai are elite jungle trolls found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
__NOTOC__ Unguloxx is the third encounter at Rank 6 of the Brawler's Guild.

Unity at a Price is a lore object located at in the back of the ground floor of the Hall of the Grand Imperion, the southernmost building in the Court of Bones on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder.
